# Third-party code in contracts/vendor

## Privacy Pools (0xbow)

`privacy-pools/src` is copied unchanged from
[0xbow-io/privacy-pools-core](https://github.com/0xbow-io/privacy-pools-core), `packages/contracts/src`,
at commit `df4bf730214bf9d0c717a9258f7a74861758c269` (24 Oct 2026), except that `BatchRelayer.sol`
and its interface are left out because QuietPay does not use them.

- Licence: Apache-2.0 (`privacy-pools/LICENSE`). Copyright 0xbow and Wonderland contributors.
- `contracts/verifiers/*Verifier.sol` are generated by snarkJS from the ceremony keys and carry
  snarkJS's GPL-3.0 header.
- Audits: Oxorio (circuits; contracts; entrypoint upgrade) and Auditware (contracts). Reports are in
  the upstream repository's `audit/` folder.
- Circuit files in `public/pool-artifacts/artifacts` (`withdraw.*`, `commitment.*`) are the
  upstream build and trusted-setup ceremony outputs. Their SHA-256 digests are pinned in
  `src/lib/pool/prover.ts` and match the digests pinned by the official SDK.

## Libraries (contracts/vendor/deps)

Only the files the pool contracts import, unchanged:

| Package | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| @openzeppelin/contracts | 5.1.0 | MIT |
| @openzeppelin/contracts-upgradeable | 5.0.2 | MIT |
| poseidon-solidity | 0.0.5 | MIT |
| @zk-kit/lean-imt.sol | 2.0.0 | MIT |

These are the versions pinned by upstream `packages/contracts/package.json`.

## Build

`npm run contracts:compile:pool` compiles with solc 0.8.28 (the upstream version), optimizer
10,000 runs and no metadata hash, as upstream's `foundry.toml`. QuietPay targets the `paris` EVM so
the bytecode does not depend on newer opcodes.

## Browser proving

Proofs use snarkjs 0.7.5 (GPL-3.0), loaded only on the pool page.

## Other brand marks

- `public/brand/walletconnect.svg`: official WalletConnect icon from WalletConnect/walletconnect-assets.
- X icon in `src/components/XLink.tsx`: from Simple Icons (CC0-1.0), used only to link to QuietPay's X account.
